items.title: Mixed signals won't help mend Sino-Japanese relations
items.description: If Takaichi genuinely wants a stable relationship, she should stop treating reconciliation as a matter of merely paying lip service. Beijing will judge Japan less by its descriptions of China than by its actions toward it. The sensible response is not another balancing act between soothing words and actions that deepen mistrust. It is to translate the stated desire for dialogue and cooperation into concrete actions.

items.title: Food an emotional bond with one's hometown
items.description: At a restaurant in Cairo, strips of beef are laid across a hot grill, the fat beginning to hiss almost immediately. Zhang Yu watches closely. He notices the color, the smoke, the timing. For a moment, the vice-president of Egypt Dongbei Chamber of Commerce and chairman of Lucky House Chinese Restaurant, looks less like a businessman and more like a man checking dinner at home.
